description: This file defines an abstract class ShareAccountBusinessEvent which extends a generic AbstractBusinessEvent class. It represents a specific type of business event related to ShareAccount entities within the Fineract project, with methods to get event category and associated ShareAccount id.

classes.name: ShareAccountBusinessEvent
classes.description: Abstract base class for ShareAccount-related business events in the Fineract infrastructure.

methods.name: ShareAccountBusinessEvent(ShareAccount value)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the event with the specified ShareAccount object.

methods.name: getCategory()
methods.description: Returns the event category string, which is fixed as 'Share'.

methods.name: getAggregateRootId()
methods.description: Returns the ID of the associated ShareAccount entity.
